purpose: Turn a request into a plan the builder can implement without asking questions.
summary: Plan adds two assertions to test_plugin_layout.py: every ADW the stamped justfile names is stamped, and every stamped ADW is either recipe-reachable or allowlisted with a reason.
commit_message: Add spec for the stamped justfile drift guard
notes_for_next_agent: The template justfile currently names adw_prompt, adw_scout, adw_plan, adw_plan_build, adw_plan_build_test, and adw_simple_sdlc. The template directory also ships adw_build, adw_build_review, adw_build_test, adw_document, adw_quality, and adw_plan_build_test_quality with no recipe; those six go in UNRECIPED_ADWS with the reason 'building blocks composed by the chained ADWs, not day-one recipes'.
